_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Sluice/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, the controller [0,0,0]: the head cell, nearest the player; the sluice runs south from it, four blocks. Nothing moves: no power cell, no work, no driver. infeedCell/infeedFace: a vanilla chute from above meets the infeed section; waterCell/waterFace: a ppex pipe meets the water inlet; tailingsCell/tailingsFace: the tailings chute leaves the tail; concentrateCell/concentrateFace: the concentrate chute leaves through the bottom face, fed from above by the launder under the riffles, which fills through their draw slots as the sluice runs. feedSpout is where the ore falls into the head box, waterSpout the nozzle's mouth, concentrateSpout where the launder pours down into the concentrate chute. buildStages: what each build stage after the frame adds, in order (the gameplay's config/builds/sluice.json). See the sluice's README for the schema.
